input: Get a comprehensive eye exam and new prescription

gold.taskTitle: Get a Comprehensive Eye Exam and New Prescription
gold.taskDescription: Schedule and complete a comprehensive eye exam to obtain an updated vision prescription.

questions.title: Do you currently have an eye doctor you use?
questions.description: Knowing if the user has an existing optometrist or ophthalmologist helps determine whether they need to find a new provider or simply book an appointment.

questions.title: Is this exam for glasses, contacts, or both?
questions.description: The type of prescription needed affects what the exam should cover and what to request from the doctor.

questions.title: When did you last have an eye exam?
questions.description: Understanding how long it has been since the last exam helps assess urgency and what insurance may cover.

questions.title: Do you have vision insurance, and do you know what it covers?
questions.description: Insurance details determine which providers are in-network and what out-of-pocket costs to expect.

questions.title: Are you experiencing any specific symptoms or vision concerns?
questions.description: Knowing about symptoms such as blurriness, headaches, or eye strain helps prioritize urgency and communicate clearly with the provider.

questions.title: What is your target timeframe for completing this exam?
questions.description: A deadline or preferred window helps structure the scheduling steps with appropriate urgency.

questions.title: Do you plan to fill the prescription at the same location?
questions.description: Whether the user intends to buy glasses or contacts at the clinic, a separate retailer, or online affects the follow-up steps after the exam.
